baseline_models.mechanism: The two negations close a sequence of recovery: practical capacity cannot produce even bodily rising, and self-redress cannot repel or answer what has happened.

activation_trace.role: Ability and practical enablement make استطاعوا the denied capacity that would initiate recovery.
Bodily erection makes قيام the first visible recovery that never occurs.
Self-vindication and resistance make منتصرين the stronger retaliatory recovery also denied.

changed_reading.before: They could not stand and were not victorious.
changed_reading.after: They could not begin even one bodily recovery, still less repel or exact redress from what struck them.

baseline_models.mechanism: قيام can name what keeps a body, livelihood, or order standing, while نصر supplies aid that makes a party prevail. The verse therefore removes both internal load-bearing organization and external or reciprocal support.

activation_trace.role: Qiwam as support, subsistence, and organizing mainstay makes قيام the system that would keep them operational.
Aid and being made manifestly stronger make منتصرين the unavailable supporting network.
Occurrence and presence in time turn the second negation into an absent state, not merely a failed isolated act.

changed_reading.before: After falling, they had no helpers.
changed_reading.after: Neither the structure by which they could remain or return to operation nor any aid network capable of restoring them was present.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ط و ع inventory inside استطاعوا, joined to قيام
baseline_models.mechanism: Behind ordinary ability, the packet preserves compliance and the self's making an action easy. Their agency can thus be heard as no longer yielding to their own attempt to muster a rising or resistance.

activation_trace.role: Compliance and following an order supply the latent image of agency that would need to yield.
The self's facilitating and encouraging an act supplies the missing internal cooperation.
Resolve and rising to undertake a matter make قيام the action their agency can no longer marshal.
Self-defense and vindication mark the intended action whose execution remains unavailable.

changed_reading.before: An external force exceeded their physical ability.
changed_reading.after: Their own capacity ceased to cooperate with intention: they could not marshal themselves into rising or self-defense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh sequence assembles authority, a strong supporting side, and mutually supporting troops, then casts the whole bloc away. That sequence makes the focus failure systemic and political as well as bodily.

activation_trace.role: Support and organizing mainstay anchor the changed reading in the focus قيام.
Mutual aid anchors the unavailable rescue function in منتصرين.
Power and rule supply the bloc's apparent capacity to act.
A strong side relied upon supplies the bloc's load-bearing support.
A mutually supporting troop body supplies organized collective aid.
Casting away supplies the terminal loss of position for the entire apparatus.

structural_cues: 51:38-40 moves from commissioned authority to Pharaoh's reliance on his flank and army, then to their joint seizure and casting.
The focus later pairs failure of قيام with failure of انتصار.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies power, support, troops, and their casting; I infer bloc organization -> apparent standing -> total collapse. A live alternative is that the focus refers only to Thamud's bodily aftermath.

changed_reading.before: The focus reports helpless individuals after a blow.
changed_reading.after: The focus also pictures the collapse of an entire power apparatus: office, strong flank, troops, and mutual aid cannot convert themselves into standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding wind is a dominating but sterile force that leaves nothing intact and converts what it reaches into decayed fragments. It activates قيام as material integrity and load-bearing persistence, not only animate posture.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant image of an erected column supplies an exploratory vertical support inside the focus form.
Mainstay and structural support anchor material persistence in قيام.
Wind as force and dominance supplies the applied destructive pressure.
The sterile wind supplies force that yields no restorative aftermath.
Leaving something behind supplies the survival condition explicitly denied by the sequence.
Transformation into a state supplies the directional change from integrity to ruin.
Decay and worn remains supply the endpoint in which no load-bearing whole persists.

structural_cues: 51:41-42 describes force, exhaustive reach, and conversion to ramim immediately before the Thamud episode.
The focus's من قيام is an absolute denial of any rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dominating wind, exhaustive destruction, and decayed residue; I infer material integrity -> capacity to stand, then destruction -> no remaining support. Alternatively, the Aad image may be parallel destruction without specifying the mechanics of 51:45.

changed_reading.before: They were too weak to get back on their feet.
changed_reading.after: The pericope makes their failure resemble loss of material integrity: nothing load-bearing remains from which a rising could be assembled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence moves from refusal of commanded obedience to a stunning seizure while they still look, then to inability. The focus capacity root's compliance branch now produces an agency reversal: chosen noncompliance is followed by agency that no longer complies with their own need to rise.

activation_trace.role: Compliance and following an order make the denied ability echo the obedience just refused.
Practical capacity supplies the later involuntary inability.
Resolve and rising to an affair make قيام the action their agency cannot undertake.
Rebellion away from obedience supplies the chosen starting posture.
A binding request supplies the command against which that posture is set.
Being stunned or dead supplies the interruption of motor and defensive agency.
Directed sight leaves awareness present at the instant effective action disappears.

structural_cues: 51:44 says they rebelled from their Lord's command and were seized while looking.
51:45 answers with two consecutive negations of capacity and self-redress.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refusal, command, stunned witnessing, and later inability; I infer refusal of compliance -> reversal into noncompliant agency. The materially live alternative is a purely chronological contrast with no reciprocal causal force.

changed_reading.before: They first disobeyed and later happened to become physically unable.
changed_reading.after: The inability answers the earlier posture: those who would not yield to the command cannot make even their own agency yield to the need to rise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats ق و م twice around كانوا. That recurrence activates the group branch inside the focus قيام: being nameable as a people does not guarantee that the collective can function as a standing body.

activation_trace.role: The people or corporate group branch lets focus قيام carry a collective body as well as an upright act.
Temporal presence frames whether a supporting collective state actually obtains.
The doubled naming of Noah's people supplies the explicit corporate form that tests the focus standing.
Their being a people supplies a durable label whose existence is distinct from effective standing.

structural_cues: قيام in 51:45 is followed immediately by قوم, كانوا, and قوم in 51:46.
The focus negates operation; the next ayah can still name a social identity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tight قيام/قوم recurrence and repeated being-language; I infer named collectivity -> possible corporate support, then distinguish that label from actual function. Alternatively, the recurrence may be lexical texture without a corporate mechanism.

changed_reading.after: A group may remain legible as a people while losing every function by which that people stands together or restores its members.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky is assembled with strength and room, while the earth is spread and prepared. These are the frame, capacity, and footing that make standing possible, so the focus failure reads as loss of a provided affordance rather than a merely local shortage of space.

activation_trace.role: Mainstay and support anchor the need for a load-bearing frame in focus قيام.
Practical capacity anchors whether the supplied environment can be used.
Construction by joining parts supplies the surrounding load-bearing frame.
Supporting strength supplies the capacity invested in that frame.
Expansion against constriction supplies room in which movement and standing could occur.
Spreading and leveling supply a usable supporting surface.
Preparing and setting an affair right supply the fitted footing for action.

structural_cues: 51:47-48 follows the failed قيام with built heaven, strength, expansion, spread earth, and preparation.
The sequence moves from unavailable standing to the cosmic conditions that ordinarily enable it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies construction, strength, room, spread, and preparation; I infer frame + capacity + footing -> affordance for standing. A live alternative is that these are independent creation signs rather than an answer to قيام.

changed_reading.before: They lacked enough strength or room to stand.
changed_reading.after: Standing itself appears as a provisioned relation among frame, capacity, and footing; the cosmos has those affordances, but they can no longer avail themselves of them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation of paired counterparts activates the focus's ما ... وما syntax as a functional pair: قيام is endogenous recovery, while انتصار is relational or retaliatory recovery. The two clauses close complementary channels rather than repeat one idea.

activation_trace.role: Bodily rising supplies the inward recovery member of the pair.
Aid and prevailing supply the relational recovery member of the pair.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the pairing logic for the two focus negations.

structural_cues: 51:45 has balanced ما ... وما clauses.
51:49 explicitly places creation in pairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a paired-negation form and a nearby counterpart image; I infer self-recovery + assisted recovery as complementary channels. Alternatively, the two focus clauses may simply intensify total helplessness.

changed_reading.before: The second clause restates the first for emphasis.
changed_reading.after: The clauses close two complementary exits: no internally generated rising and no relational aid or counteraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The imperative to flee and the warning that awakens caution restore directed movement only before the terminal condition. The focus becomes a deadline image: once seizure has arrived, neither delayed rising nor self-rescue remains.

activation_trace.role: Failed bodily rising supplies the immobility that makes prior flight urgent.
Unavailable self-defense supplies the failure of a later attempt to escape the consequence.
Flight supplies the still-open movement that must precede terminal incapacity.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the temporal signal for acting while movement remains possible.

structural_cues: The failed movement of 51:45 is followed by the imperative ففروا in 51:50.
The imperative is paired with an explicit warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies terminal immobility, later flight, and warning; I infer warning -> timely directed movement before closure. Alternatively, 51:50 may begin a general exhortation rather than define the timing of 51:45.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a static picture of defeated people.
changed_reading.after: The focus marks the far side of a deadline: flight toward refuge is possible now, but no autonomous recovery remains after the event fixes them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated accusation becomes a saying circulated among peoples, and mutual counsel binds a transgressing group. The packet thus distinguishes social coordination from true نصر: a group can transmit and reinforce refusal yet remain unable to rescue itself.

activation_trace.role: The group branch anchors the reading in the collective potential of focus قيام.
Mutual aid supplies the effective coordination that their actual solidarity cannot become.
A saying spread among people supplies the repeated rejection script.
Mutual counsel among a group supplies intergenerational-seeming coordination.
The named people supply the corporate carrier of that script.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the shared direction of their coordination.

structural_cues: 51:52 repeats the same sorcerer-or-mad accusation already voiced in 51:39.
51:53 asks about mutual counsel, then names a transgressing people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated slogan, mutual counsel, a people, and transgression; I infer message circulation -> group cohesion without effective aid. Alternatively, أتواصوا may deny literal coordination and mark only recurrent disposition.

changed_reading.before: They had no social organization capable of helping them.
changed_reading.after: They possessed real coordination, but it organized refusal rather than rescue; cohesion alone is not the نصر denied by the focus.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creaturely service is set beside a denial that God needs their feeding, while feeding itself carries a branch of capacity and God is named giver of apportioned provision, concentrated strength, and extended solidity. The focus incapacity now exposes derivative power rather than a momentary shortage.

activation_trace.role: Practical enablement anchors the creaturely capacity whose dependence is disclosed.
That by which a thing subsists anchors the question of who supplies standing.
Aid anchors the unavailable attempt to source restoration from themselves or peers.
Submissive obedience supplies the proper direction of creaturely agency.
Capacity over a thing inside the feeding root supplies a surprising echo of the focus ability language.
Apportioned giving supplies subsistence from outside the creatures.
Concentrated strength like strands of a rope supplies power that does not disperse under load.
Extended solidity supplies the firm load-bearing quality absent from the defeated state.

structural_cues: 51:56-58 moves through service, denial of divine need for creaturely provision, and the divine names of provision, strength, and firmness.
51:45 has already denied the creatures' ability to rise or restore themselves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies service, no need for creaturely feeding, apportioned provision, strength, and solidity; I infer source of subsistence -> source of standing capacity. Alternatively, the later claims may establish divine independence without directly explaining the focus collapse.

changed_reading.before: Their normal power was temporarily overwhelmed by a stronger event.
changed_reading.after: Their failure reveals that capacity, subsistence, and restoration were always received; concentrated and firm strength is not theirs to originate.

context_deltas.mechanism: A matched share is assigned to wrongdoers like the share of their companions, and haste cannot move its appointed arrival. Social relation therefore becomes a distribution channel for equivalent consequence, not a rescue coalition.

activation_trace.role: Aid and making prevail anchor the social function that companionship fails to deliver.
An allotted share supplies the consequence distributed across linked parties.
An equivalent counterpart supplies the matching rule for those shares.
Companionship supplies the social linkage that carries sameness of outcome rather than aid.
Hastening and bringing forward supply the attempted but forbidden change of schedule.
An appointment fixed by time supplies the endpoint that social ties cannot defer.

structural_cues: 51:59 links wrongdoers to companions by matching shares and bars haste.
51:60 closes on their promised day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equivalent shares, companionship, barred haste, and an appointment; I infer social linkage -> distribution of outcome rather than interruption of it. Alternatively, companions may mean only earlier analogues with no claim about failed coalition.

changed_reading.before: They lacked companions who might help.
changed_reading.after: Companionship remains operative, but perversely: it aligns and schedules matching consequences instead of supplying any route back to standing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because س ط ع is a non-dominant mapping of the focus root and its column image is form-distant. It remains packet-authorized and is anchored by قيام plus the later construction supports; downstream prose should present it only as a vertical visual echo, never as the lexical meaning of استطاعوا.

activation_trace.role: An erected tent-column supplies a form-distant image of failed vertical support.
A standing implement or component makes قيام a concrete upright member.
Ribs and structural supports supply the nearby architecture against which their missing upright member is seen.

changed_reading.before: They lacked an abstract ability to stand.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their whole vertical profile is erased: no raised support, standing component, or column can be presented.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the only packet branch for ف س ق is the botanical image of a ripe date slipping from its peel. The repeated قيام/قوم root keeps the analogy anchored in collective standing; downstream prose should mark it as a material analogy for lost cohesion, not an etymological definition of moral transgression.

activation_trace.role: A sustaining mainstay makes قيام the cohesion by which a collective holds together.
The doubled people-name supplies the collective body whose cohesion is being tested.
A ripe date slipping from its peel supplies the contained body's loss of its holding envelope.

changed_reading.before: A people exists as a stable container for mutual support.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the people remains a name after the body has slipped its containing cohesion, leaving no corporate قيام.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain hydraulic reading is surprising because منتصرين ordinarily concerns aid, while the packet also preserves rain-relief and water-channel branches. It remains anchored directly in ن ص ر and is sharpened by provision as rain and ذنوب as a full bucket; downstream prose should qualify it as an imagistic reversal, not translate the focus as a water scene.

activation_trace.role: Rain as relief and rescue supplies the absent restorative inflow.
Channels arriving from afar at gathered water supply a route by which outside relief might have reached them.
Rain descending as provision links restorative inflow to the true provider.
A full bucket supplies the reversal: what arrives is an allotted load of consequence rather than relief.

changed_reading.before: No ally came to help them.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, no relieving inflow or distant rescue-channel reaches them; the only full measure arriving is their allotted consequence.

strongest_changes: The immediate عتوا/أمر sequence changes neutral incapacity into a reversal from refused compliance to agency that no longer yields to the need to rise.
The Pharaoh bloc changes bodily helplessness into collapse of authority, strong flank, troops, and mutual aid as one operating system.
The built, strengthened, expanded, and prepared cosmos changes standing into a provided affordance of frame, capacity, and footing.
The later service, provision, strength, and firmness sequence changes temporary weakness into disclosure that creaturely capacity and subsistence are derivative.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's paired negations separate internal rising from relational rescue, while packet-authorized edge branches preserve three unusually concrete images: failed vertical support, a collective slipping its shell, and relief-water reversed into an allotted bucket.
remaining_uncertainties: The refusal-to-incapacity arrow is a reader inference from sequence and root contrast, not an explicit causal statement.
The س ط ع column activation is formally licensed by the split mapping but remains distant from the ordinary استطاعوا sense.
The cosmic architecture and later provision contrasts may be deliberate mechanisms across the pericope or looser juxtapositions.
The botanical and hydraulic outliers should remain exploratory images and must not control a lexical translation.
